backend_missing_heading: The backend settings API is not available.
backend_missing_help: Deploy a backend version with the /api/settings routes to the preview or staging environment, then try again. The form is locked to prevent empty data from overwriting the configuration.
load_failed_help: Check your connection and Super Admin permissions, then try loading again.
reset_confirmation: Restore branding and maintenance settings to their defaults? This will turn off maintenance mode and be recorded in the audit log.
section_description: Edit branding, contact details, and maintenance notices. Images are format-validated and uploaded to the existing asset store.
maintenance_help: When enabled, the storefront displays the maintenance notice page. APIs, payment callbacks, health checks, and Super Admin access remain available.
maintenance_placeholder: The website is being upgraded. Please check back later.
audit_subtitle: Only the actor, changed fields, and version are recorded.
